ambient.name: Social Drifter
ambient.description: Investigates peers, loosely regroups and aligns with copied motion, then disperses after a local congregation. Shared tags affect who attracts it; no private peer intentions are read.

ambient.name: Timid Follower
ambient.description: Stays at a broad comfortable distance, follows a copied companion or assigned peer and retreats early from Water and disliked actors. Low activity makes its approaches hesitant.

ambient.name: Territorial Watcher
ambient.description: Keeps near its home, briefly watches passing compatible peers and retreats from disliked tags. Add an interest region to give it an authored activity area.

ambient.name: Independent Wanderer
ambient.description: Chooses finite seeded destinations without preferring familiar peers. It keeps personal space, tries alternative directions around obstacles and occasionally makes a homeward trip.

ambient.name: Homebody Keeper
ambient.description: Takes short local trips, inspects new material without long pursuits and spends finite intervals back at home. Editable activity regions can give it a favourite workplace.
